name: blicca-staticresourceoverride
description: Blicca (Plone Classic UI) pattern and Svelte component overrides — training add-on

dependenciesComments.@patternslib/patternslib: Has to match the Patternslib version of the Mockup release in plone.staticresources (module federation shared dependencies!).
dependenciesComments.@plone/mockup: Has to match the Mockup version shipped with the deployed Plone (plone.staticresources). Needs the Svelte runtime shared via module federation (mockup master since 2026-07-29, commit 6c27e8f3e) — TODO: switch to the first release containing it (5.7.0 or a 5.6.x backport).
dependenciesComments.@plone/registry: Component registry — use the same major/minor as Mockup so the instance is shared via module federation.
dependenciesComments.svelte: Must match Mockup's Svelte version: host and add-on share one runtime instance (singleton) via module federation.
